en.s: The naval Battle of Naulochus was fought on 3 September 36 BC between the fleets of Sextus Pompeius and Marcus Vipsanius Agrippa, off Naulochus, Sicily. The victory of Agrippa, admiral of Octavian, marked the end of the Pompeian resistance to the Second Triumvirate.

zh.s: 纳乌洛库斯海战于公元前36年9月3日在西西里岛附近爆发，交战双方是塞克斯图斯·庞培和马库斯·维普萨尼乌斯·阿格里帕率领的舰队。阿格里帕是屋大维的海军将领；他的胜利标志着庞培派对第二次三头同盟的抵抗结束。

en.t: Consecration of Pope Gregory I (Gregory the Great)
en.s: Pope Gregory I (Latin: Gregorius I; Gregorio I; c. 540 – 12 March 604), commonly known as Saint Gregory the Great (Latin: Sanctus Gregorius Magnus; Italian: San Gregorio Magno), was the 64th Bishop of Rome from 3 September 590 until his death on 12 March 604. A Roman senator's son, and himself the prefect of Rome at 30, Gregory lived in a monastery that he established on his family estate before becoming a papal ambassador and then pope.

zh.t: 教皇格列高利一世（大格列高利）祝圣
zh.s: 教皇格列高利一世（拉丁名：Gregorius I、Gregorio I；约540年—604年3月12日），通常称为圣大格列高利（拉丁名：Sanctus Gregorius Magnus；意大利名：San Gregorio Magno），于590年9月3日起担任第64任罗马主教，直至604年3月12日去世。他是罗马元老的儿子，30岁时自己也曾任罗马行政长官。成为教皇使节、继而当选教皇前，格列高利曾住在自己建于家族庄园上的修道院里。

en.s: The Battle of Lalakaon (Greek: Μάχη τοῦ Λαλακάοντος), or Battle of Poson or Porson (Μάχη τοῦ Πό(ρ)σωνος), was fought in 863 between the Byzantine Empire and an invading Arab army in Paphlagonia (modern northern Turkey). The Byzantine army was led by Petronas, the uncle of Emperor Michael III, although Arab sources also mention the presence of the Emperor in person.

zh.s: 拉拉卡翁战役（希腊语：Μάχη τοῦ Λαλακάοντος）又称波松战役或波尔松战役（希腊语：Μάχη τοῦ Πό(ρ)σωνος），于863年在帕弗拉戈尼亚（今土耳其北部）爆发，交战双方是拜占庭帝国和入侵的阿拉伯军队。拜占庭军由皇帝米海尔三世的叔父佩特罗纳斯指挥；阿拉伯史料还提到皇帝本人也在场。

en.s: The Battle of Montepeloso was fought on 3 September 1041 between Lombard-Norman rebel forces and the Byzantine Empire, near Montepeloso in southern Italy. The Byzantines, led by Exaugustus Boioannes, were forced into battle by the rebels, and after a day-long fight the rebels defeated the Byzantine army and captured Boioannes. The decisive rebel victory forced the Byzantines to retreat to the coastal cities, leaving the Normans and Lombards in control of the whole interior of southern Italy.

zh.s: 1041年9月3日，伦巴第—诺曼叛军与拜占庭帝国军队在意大利南部蒙特佩洛索附近交战。叛军迫使由埃克萨古斯都·博伊奥安内斯率领的拜占庭军队迎战。经过一整天战斗，叛军击败拜占庭军并俘虏博伊奥安内斯。叛军决定性获胜，迫使拜占庭军退往沿海城市，诺曼人和伦巴第人因此控制了意大利南部整个内陆地区。

en.t: Richard I is crowned king of England at Westminster Abbey
en.s: On September 3, 1189, Richard I was crowned king of England at Westminster Abbey. A surviving detailed account describes his procession from the Palace of Westminster, his oath and anointing, and the Archbishop of Canterbury placing the crown on his head. Richard had succeeded his father Henry II earlier that year.
en.n: The coronation took place September 3, 1189, at Westminster Abbey.

zh.t: 理查一世在威斯敏斯特教堂加冕为英格兰国王
zh.s: 1189年9月3日，理查一世在伦敦威斯敏斯特教堂加冕为英格兰国王。留存的记述详细描写了他从威斯敏斯特宫前往教堂、宣誓、接受涂油礼，以及坎特伯雷大主教为他戴上王冠的过程。此前，他已继承父亲亨利二世的王位。
zh.n: 加冕礼于1189年9月3日在威斯敏斯特教堂举行。

en.s: The siege of Silves was an action of the Third Crusade and the Portuguese Reconquista in 1189. The city of Silves in the Almohad Caliphate was besieged from 21 July until 3 September by the forces of Portugal and a group of crusaders from northern Europe on their way to the siege of Acre. The defenders capitulated on terms, the city was handed over to Portugal and the crusaders took a portion of the spoils.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 西尔维什围城战是1189年第三次十字军东征和葡萄牙收复失地运动中的一场战事。葡萄牙军队和一支正前往围攻阿克城的北欧十字军部队，从7月21日起围攻穆瓦希德王朝境内的西尔维什城，直至9月3日。守军按约定条件投降，城市移交给葡萄牙，十字军则分得部分战利品。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Ain Jalut (Ayn Jalut, in Arabic: عين جالوت, the "Spring of Goliath", or Harod Spring, in Hebrew: מעין חרוד) took place on 3 September 1260 between Muslim Mamluks and the Mongols in the southeastern Galilee, in the Jezreel Valley, not far from the site of Zir'in. The battle marked the south-westernmost extent of Mongol conquests, and was the first time a Mongol advance had been permanently halted. This was blamed on the sudden death of the then-Khagan Möngke Khan; an event that forced the Mongol Ilkhanate Hulagu Khan to take a large part of his army back with him on the way to Mongolia.

zh.s: 艾因·贾鲁特战役（阿拉伯语：عين جالوت，意为“歌利亚之泉”；希伯来语：מעין חרוד，称哈罗德泉）于1260年9月3日在加利利东南部的耶斯列谷爆发，交战双方是穆斯林马穆鲁克和蒙古军队，地点距齐林遗址不远。此战标志着蒙古征服范围向西南所达的最远处，也是蒙古军队首次被永久阻止继续推进。人们将这一结果归因于当时大汗蒙哥突然去世；这迫使蒙古伊儿汗国统治者旭烈兀带领大批军队返回蒙古。

en.s: The siege of Romorantin took place between 29 August and 3 September 1356, when an Anglo-Gascon army under the Black Prince – the eldest son and heir to King Edward III of England – assaulted the town and castle of Romorantin during the Hundred Years' War. The small French garrison was commanded by Jean Boucicaut, the marshal of France, and surrendered after six days.

zh.s: 百年战争期间，黑太子爱德华率领的英格兰—加斯科涅军队于1356年8月29日至9月3日围攻罗莫朗坦镇及城堡。黑太子是英格兰国王爱德华三世的长子和继承人。法国小规模守军由法国元帅让·布西科指挥，坚守六天后投降。

en.s: The siege of Lisbon was a siege of the city of Lisbon from 29 May to 3 September 1384. It was a part of the 1383-1385 Crisis, and occurred between the Portuguese defenders of the city led by John I of Portugal and the Castillian army led by King John I of Castile. The siege ended in a disaster for Castile.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1384年5月29日至9月3日，葡萄牙国王若昂一世率领的守军与卡斯蒂利亚国王胡安一世率领的军队围绕里斯本交战。此战是1383至1385年葡萄牙王位危机的一部分，最终以卡斯蒂利亚惨败告终。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Treaty of Selymbria was an agreement concluded on 3 September 1411 between the Republic of Venice and the Ottoman prince Musa Çelebi, ruler of the European portion of the Ottoman Empire (Rumelia), at Selymbria. The treaty largely repeated previous agreements between Venice and Ottoman rulers, and recognized the possessions of the Republic in Greece and Albania.

zh.s: 塞利姆布里亚条约于1411年9月3日在塞利姆布里亚签订，签约双方是威尼斯共和国和奥斯曼王子穆萨·切莱比；他统治着奥斯曼帝国的欧洲部分鲁米利亚。条约大体重申了威尼斯与奥斯曼统治者此前达成的协议，并承认威尼斯共和国在希腊和阿尔巴尼亚的领地。

en.s: The Spanish assault on Djerba was a 1510 military expedition directed by Ferdinand II of Aragon against the Tunisian island of Djerba. It resulted in the death of several thousand soldiers and is often known as the Djerba Disaster (Spanish: Desastre de los Gelves).
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 西班牙远征杰尔巴岛（1510年）
zh.s: 西班牙远征杰尔巴岛是阿拉贡国王斐迪南二世于1510年针对突尼斯杰尔巴岛发动的一次军事远征，造成数千名士兵死亡。这次行动也常被称为“杰尔巴灾难”（西班牙语：Desastre de los Gelves）。
zh.n: 本条目记录的是来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The siege of Székesfehérvár started in the month of August in 1543 when the Ottomans laid siege to the fortress. Székesfehérvár was a key fortification in the frontier area extending in the western foreground of Budin. In 1543 the garrison numbered 6,000 troops. On 22 August 1543 the Ottomans laid siege to the castle from three directions.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1543年8月，奥斯曼帝国开始围攻塞克什白堡要塞。该要塞是布达附近西部边境地区的重要防御工事。1543年，守军有6,000人。8月22日，奥斯曼军从三个方向围攻城堡。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The siege of Meurs took place between 29 August to 3 September 1597 during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War. The Spanish occupied city of Moers (Dutch at the time: Meurs) under Governor Andrés de Miranda was besieged by Dutch and English troops under the command of Prince Maurice of Orange. The siege ended with the capitulation and the withdrawal of the Spanish garrison.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 八十年战争和英西战争期间，1597年8月29日至9月3日，荷兰和英国军队围攻由西班牙占领的默尔斯城。莫里斯亲王指挥联军，城内西班牙守军由安德烈斯·德·米兰达总督统领。围城最终以西班牙守军投降并撤出告终。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Moscow was a series of two engagements that took place in Moscow on 1 and 3 September 1612, during the Polish–Russian War of 1609–1618 and the Time of Troubles. The forces of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth were commanded by Field Hetman Jan Karol Chodkiewicz, while the Russians were led by Prince Dmitry Pozharsky. The engagements ended in decisive Russian victories.

zh.s: 莫斯科战役由两场交战组成，于1612年9月1日和3日在莫斯科发生，属于1609至1618年的波兰—俄罗斯战争和俄罗斯混乱时期。波兰立陶宛联邦军队由大盖特曼扬·卡罗尔·霍德凯维奇指挥，俄军则由德米特里·波扎尔斯基公爵率领。两场交战均以俄军决定性胜利告终。

en.t: Later Jin forces capture Tieling from the Ming dynasty
en.s: On September 3, 1619, forces led by Nurhaci attacked and captured the Ming stronghold of Tieling in present-day Liaoning, China. It was one of the Later Jin advances into northeastern Ming territory that year, following its capture of Kaiyuan in July.
en.n: The battle is dated September 3, 1619, equivalent to the twenty-fifth day of the seventh lunar month in the forty-seventh year of the Wanli reign.

zh.t: 后金军队攻占明朝铁岭
zh.s: 1619年9月3日，努尔哈赤率军进攻并攻占明朝铁岭城，即今中国辽宁省铁岭市。这是后金当年向明朝东北地区推进的一部分，此前后金已于7月攻占开原。
zh.n: 此战记载日期为1619年9月3日，即万历四十七年农历七月二十五日。

en.s: The Battle of Cabañas was an attempt in 1638 by Dutch privateer Cornelis Jol to capture the Spanish treasure fleet captained by Carlos de Ibarra. The naval battle, framed in the Eighty Years' War, ended with the Dutch fleet retreating after suffering heavy damage.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1638年，荷兰私掠船长科内利斯·约尔试图夺取卡洛斯·德·伊瓦拉指挥的西班牙宝船舰队，双方由此爆发卡瓦尼亚斯海战。此战属于八十年战争的一部分，荷兰舰队遭受重创后撤退。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Cartagena was a naval battle fought on September 3, 1643 during the Thirty Years' War off Cape de Gate near Cartagena, Spain. After a series of victories in 1641 and 1642 the French Navy dominated the Western Mediterranean Sea. France was also in control of most of Catalonia after the Catalan Revolt. At that time, the Spanish Navy did not dare to show itself off the Catalan coast.

zh.s: 三十年战争期间，1643年9月3日，西班牙卡塔赫纳附近的加塔角外海发生海战。法国海军在1641年和1642年连续获胜后，主导了西地中海。加泰罗尼亚起义后，法国也控制了加泰罗尼亚大部分地区。当时，西班牙海军不敢出现在加泰罗尼亚沿岸。

en.s: The Battle of Dunbar (3 September 1650) was a battle of the Third English Civil War. The English Parliamentarian forces under Oliver Cromwell defeated a Scottish army commanded by David Leslie which was loyal to King Charles II, who had been proclaimed King of Scots and crowned at Scone. Charles was pronounced King of Great Britain, Ireland and France on 5 February 1649. The battlefield has been inventoried and protected by Historic Scotland under the Historic Environment (Amendment) Act 2011.

zh.s: 邓巴战役于1650年9月3日爆发，是第三次英国内战中的一场战斗。奥利弗·克伦威尔率领英格兰议会派军队，击败了大卫·莱斯利指挥的苏格兰军队。莱斯利的军队效忠于查理二世；查理已在斯昆加冕为苏格兰国王。1649年2月5日，查理被宣布为大不列颠、爱尔兰和法国国王。苏格兰历史古迹局依据《2011年历史环境修正法》对战场进行登记并加以保护。

en.s: The Battle of Worcester took place on 3 September 1651 at Worcester, England, and was the final battle of the English Civil War. Oliver Cromwell's Parliamentarian "New Model Army", 28,000 strong, defeated King Charles II's 16,000 Royalists, of whom the vast majority were Scottish.

zh.s: 伍斯特战役于1651年9月3日在英格兰伍斯特爆发，是英国内战的最后一场战斗。奥利弗·克伦威尔率领2.8万人的议会军“新模范军”，击败了查理二世的1.6万名保王党军队；后者大多数是苏格兰人。

en.s: The Battle of Ulan Butung was fought on 3 September 1690 between the forces of the Qing dynasty and those of the Dzungar Khanate. When attacked by the superior Qing army, the Dzungars formed a camel wall to defend their camp and defeated Qing assaults on their right flank, but were driven back on the left. They were able to withdraw into the wooded hills behind their camp in good order. The Qing commander, Fuquan, reported it as a victory, but was discredited by political opponents.

zh.s: 乌兰布通之战于1690年9月3日爆发，交战双方是清朝和准噶尔汗国的军队。清军兵力占优，准噶尔人便用骆驼组成防线保护营地。他们击退了清军对右翼的进攻，但左翼被清军击退，随后有序撤入营地后方的林木丘陵。清军将领福全将此战上报为胜利，但因此受到政敌诋毁。

en.s: The siege of Tournai was a siege of the city of Tournai, then part of the Kingdom of France, between 28 June and 3 September 1709. A Grand Alliance army under the British Duke of Marlborough successfully forced the surrender of the French garrison during the War of the Spanish Succession. The siege was the first significant engagement of the 1709 campaign.

zh.s: 1709年6月28日至9月3日，西班牙王位继承战争期间，大同盟军围攻当时属于法国王国的图尔奈。英国马尔伯勒公爵率领的联军迫使法国守军投降。这是1709年战役中的首次重要交战。

en.s: The Battle at Chignecto happened during Father Le Loutre's War when Charles Lawrence, in command of the 45th Regiment of Foot (Hugh Warburton's regiment) and the 47th Regiment (Peregrine Lascelles' regiment), John Gorham in command of the Rangers and Captain John Rous in command of the navy, fought against the French monarchists at Chignecto. This battle was the first attempt by the British to occupy the head of the Bay of Fundy since the disastrous Battle of Grand Pré three years earlier. They fought against a militia made up of Mi'kmaq and Acadians led by Jean-Louis Le Loutre and Joseph Broussard (Beausoliel). The battle happened at Isthmus of Chignecto, Nova Scotia on 3 September 1750.

zh.s: 奇涅克托战役发生于勒卢特神父战争期间。查尔斯·劳伦斯率领第45步兵团（休·沃伯顿的团）和第47团（佩里格林·拉斯塞尔斯的团），约翰·戈勒姆指挥游骑兵队，海军的约翰·鲁斯上尉也参与其中，他们在奇涅克托与法国保皇派交战。这是英国自三年前在大普雷战役惨败后，首次试图占领芬迪湾顶端地区。他们面对的是一支由米克马克人和阿卡迪亚人组成的民兵，领袖为让-路易·勒卢特和约瑟夫·布鲁萨尔（“美善者”）。战斗于1750年9月3日在新斯科舍省奇涅克托地峡爆发。

en.s: The First Cevallos expedition was a series of Spanish military operations in South America during the Fantastic War. Under the command of the governor of Buenos Aires, Pedro de Cevallos, the expedition captured the Portuguese settlement of Colónia do Sacramento and fought off a joint Anglo-Portuguese attempt to recapture it. All military activities in the region concluded with the 1763 Treaty of Paris. In 1762, Spain entered the Seven Years' War on the side of France as part of the Family Compact, motivated in part by diplomatic efforts on the part of the French government. Having been notified months in advance that Spain was planning to enter the conflict and declare war on Portugal, Cevallos launched an expedition against Colónia do Sacramento on 3 September 1762, sailing at the head of an expeditionary fleet from Buenos Aires which carried 2,700 soldiers.

zh.s: 塞瓦略斯第一次远征是西班牙在南美洲发动的一系列军事行动，发生于“奇妙战争”期间。远征由布宜诺斯艾利斯总督佩德罗·德·塞瓦略斯指挥，西班牙军队攻占葡萄牙人的科洛尼亚·德尔萨克拉门托，并击退英葡联军的收复行动。该地区的军事行动最终随着1763年《巴黎条约》签订而结束。1762年，西班牙在波旁家族协定框架下加入七年战争，站在法国一方，部分原因是法国政府的外交努力。塞瓦略斯提前数月获知西班牙计划参战并对葡萄牙宣战，于1762年9月3日从布宜诺斯艾利斯出发，率领载有2700名士兵的远征舰队，进攻科洛尼亚·德尔萨克拉门托。

en.s: The Battle of Cooch's Bridge, also known as the Battle of Iron Hill, was a battle fought on September 3, 1777, between the Continental Army and American militia and primarily German soldiers serving alongside the British Army during the American Revolutionary War. It was the only significant military action during the war on the soil of Delaware (though there were also naval engagements off the state's coast), and it took place about a week before the major Battle of Brandywine. Reportedly, the battle saw the first flying of the American flag.

zh.s: 库奇桥战役又称铁山战役，于1777年9月3日爆发，是美国独立战争期间大陆军和美国民兵与英军之间的一场战斗，英军一方以德国士兵为主。这是独立战争期间特拉华州境内唯一一次重要军事行动（该州沿岸也发生过海战），时间比布兰迪万战役早约一周。据称，美军在此战中首次升起美国国旗。

en.s: The Battle of Trincomalee was fought between a British fleet under Vice-Admiral Sir Edward Hughes and a French fleet under the Bailli de Suffren off the coast of Trincomalee, then Ceylon (modern Sri Lanka), on 3 September 1782. It was the fourth in a series of battles fought between the two fleets off the coast of the Indian subcontinent during the Anglo-French War.

zh.s: 1782年9月3日，英国海军中将爱德华·休斯爵士率领的舰队与苏弗朗骑士指挥的法国舰队，在当时称锡兰（今斯里兰卡）的亭可马里近海交战。这是英法战争期间，两支舰队在印度次大陆沿岸一系列海战中的第四场。

en.s: The Treaty of Paris, signed in Paris by representatives of King George III of Great Britain and representatives of the United States of America on September 3, 1783, ended the American Revolutionary War. Britain acknowledged the United States to be sovereign and independent. The treaty set the boundaries between the British Empire and the new country, on lines "exceedingly generous" to the United States.

zh.s: 《巴黎条约》于1783年9月3日在巴黎签署，签署方为大不列颠国王乔治三世的代表和美利坚合众国的代表。条约结束了美国独立战争，英国承认美国是主权独立国家，并划定了大英帝国与这个新国家之间的边界；这些边界被认为“对美国极为有利”。

en.s: The Battle of Würzburg was fought on 3 September 1796 between an army of Habsburg Austria led by Archduke Charles, Duke of Teschen and an army of the First French Republic led by Jean-Baptiste Jourdan. The French attacked the archduke's forces, but they were resisted until the arrival of reinforcements decided the engagement in favor of the Austrians. The French retreated west toward the Rhine River. The action occurred during the War of the First Coalition, part of the French Revolutionary Wars. Würzburg is 95 kilometres (59 mi) southeast of Frankfurt.

zh.s: 1796年9月3日，特申公爵卡尔大公率领的哈布斯堡奥地利军队与让-巴蒂斯特·儒尔当率领的法兰西第一共和国军队交战。法军发动进攻，但奥军坚守阵地，援军到达后，战局转向奥军一方。法军向西撤往莱茵河。此战发生在第一次反法同盟战争期间，该战争是法国大革命战争的一部分。维尔茨堡位于法兰克福东南95公里（59英里）处。

en.s: The Battle of St. George's Caye was a military engagement that lasted from 3 to 10 September 1798, off the coast of British Honduras (present-day Belize). However, the name is typically reserved for the final battle that occurred on 10 September in which the Spanish were defeated. The events of 10 September 1798 marked the final Spanish attempt to take over the area.
en.n: The week long battle of St. George's Caye begins between Spain and Britain off the coast of Belize.

zh.s: 圣乔治礁战役是英国洪都拉斯（今伯利兹）海岸外的一场军事交战，持续时间为1798年9月3日至10日。不过，这个名称通常专指9月10日发生的最后一场战斗；西班牙军队在该战中被击败。1798年9月10日的事件标志着西班牙最后一次试图夺取该地区。
zh.n: 圣乔治礁为期一周的战役在伯利兹海岸外爆发，交战双方是西班牙和英国。

en.s: The Battle of Deligrad (Serbian: Битка на Делиграду, romanized: Bitka na Deligradu) was fought between Serbian revolutionaries and an army of the Ottoman Empire, and took place on 3 September 1806 during the First Serbian Uprising. A 55,000-strong Ottoman army commanded by Albanian Pasha of Scutari Ibrahim Pasha was defeated with heavy casualties and the loss of nine guns by Grand Vozhd Karađorđe Petrović's 37,000 Serbian rebels at Deligrad in Serbia.

zh.s: 塞尔维亚起义军与奥斯曼帝国军队于1806年9月3日在第一次塞尔维亚起义期间爆发德利格勒战役。斯库台的阿尔巴尼亚帕夏易卜拉欣帕夏率领5.5万名奥斯曼军队，在塞尔维亚德利格勒被卡拉乔尔杰·彼得罗维奇大公率领的3.7万名塞尔维亚起义军击败。奥斯曼军伤亡惨重，并损失9门火炮。

en.s: The Battle of Hampden was an action in the British campaign to conquer present-day Maine and remake it into the colony of New Ireland during the War of 1812. Sir John Sherbrooke led a British force from Halifax, Nova Scotia, to establish New Ireland, which lasted until the end of the war, eight months later. Revenues from the short-lived colony funded a military library in Halifax and the Dalhousie College.

zh.s: 1812年战争期间，英国军队发动汉普登战役，试图征服今缅因州，并将其改为新爱尔兰殖民地。约翰·舍布鲁克爵士率军从新斯科舍省哈利法克斯出发，建立了新爱尔兰。这个短命殖民地维持到8个月后的战争结束，其收入被用于资助哈利法克斯的一座军事图书馆和达尔豪斯学院。

en.t: Vermont voters reelect William A. Palmer as governor
en.s: Vermont held its governor election on September 3, 1833. Incumbent William A. Palmer received 20,565 of 38,905 votes, a majority, defeating Ezra Meech and other candidates. The vote gave the Anti-Masonic governor another one-year term. Later October proceedings recorded the results but were not the date voters went to the polls.
en.n: Voters cast ballots September 3, 1833; the legislature considered the returns in October.

zh.t: 佛蒙特州选民连任州长威廉·A·帕尔默
zh.s: 佛蒙特州于1833年9月3日举行州长选举。时任州长威廉·A·帕尔默获得38,905张选票中的20,565张，赢得多数票，击败埃兹拉·米奇等候选人。这次投票让反共济会党籍州长再获一年的任期。州议会于10月审议并记录选举结果，但选民实际投票日是9月3日。
zh.n: 选民于1833年9月3日投票；州议会于10月审议选票结果。

en.s: The 1838 Republic of Texas presidential election was the second presidential election. It was held on September 3, 1838. By a provision of the constitution, the term of office of the first president was limited to two years, without his being eligible for re-election; succeeding presidents were to hold their office for three years.

zh.t: 1838年德克萨斯共和国总统选举
zh.s: 1838年德克萨斯共和国总统选举是该共和国第二次总统选举，于9月3日举行。根据宪法规定，首任总统任期为两年，且不得连任；此后的总统任期为三年。

en.s: The Cambodian uprising of 1840–1841 was a general uprising of Khmer people against direct Vietnamese rule in September 1840. In response to Siamese invasion of Cambodia and Southern Vietnam in 1833, the Vietnamese Nguyen dynasty had annexed Cambodia into Trấn Tây Province in 1835 with Ang Mey as puppet female ruler under Trương Minh Giảng.

zh.s: 1840至1841年柬埔寨起义是高棉人反抗越南直接统治的一场大规模起义，始于1840年9月。1833年暹罗入侵柬埔寨和越南南部后，越南阮朝于1835年吞并柬埔寨，将其划为镇西省，并让安眉担任傀儡女王，由张明讲控制。

en.s: The 3 September 1843 Revolution (Greek: Επανάσταση της 3ης Σεπτεμβρίου 1843; N.S. 13 September), was an uprising by the Greek Army in Athens, supported by large sections of the people, against the autocratic rule of King Otto. The rebels, led by veterans of the Greek War of Independence, demanded the granting of a constitution and the departure of the Bavarian officials that dominated the government.

zh.s: 1843年9月3日革命（希腊语：Επανάσταση της 3ης Σεπτεμβρίου 1843；新历9月13日）是希腊军队在雅典发动的一场起义，得到了许多民众支持，反对奥托国王的专制统治。由希腊独立战争老兵领导的起义者要求颁布宪法，并要求主导政府的巴伐利亚官员离开。

en.s: The 1844 Vermont gubernatorial election was held on September 3, 1844. Following the suicide of his son, George, in January, incumbent Whig Governor John Mattocks declined to run for re-election. Whig nominee William Slade defeated Democratic nominee Daniel Kellogg and Liberty nominee William R. Shafter with 51.53% of the vote.

zh.s: 佛蒙特州于1844年9月3日举行州长选举。时任辉格党州长约翰·马托克斯的儿子乔治于当年1月自杀，之后马托克斯决定不再竞选连任。辉格党候选人威廉·斯莱德击败民主党候选人丹尼尔·凯洛格和自由党候选人威廉·R·沙夫特，得票率为51.53%。

en.s: The Battle of La Virgen occurred on 3 September 1855, at La Virgen, Nicaragua. It was part of the Legitimist efforts to resist the newly arrived force of William Walker, who had the support of the fierce opponents of the Legitimists, the Democrats. After a hard-fought but one-sided skirmish, Walker's forces emerged victorious, giving the cause of the invading Filibuster army legitimacy, and inspiring many new volunteers to join his force.

zh.s: 1855年9月3日，拉维尔亨战役在尼加拉瓜的拉维尔亨爆发。这场战役是正统派抵抗威廉·沃克新近抵达的部队的一部分。沃克得到正统派强劲对手民主派的支持。经过一场激烈但胜负悬殊的交战，沃克的部队获胜，这让入侵者菲利布斯特军队的行动获得了正当性，也吸引许多新志愿者加入他的队伍。

en.s: The Battle of Ash Hollow, also known as the Battle of Blue Water Creek or the Harney Massacre, was an engagement of the First Sioux War, fought on September 2 and 3, 1855, between United States Army soldiers under Brig. Gen. William S. Harney and a band of the Sicangu Lakota along the Platte River in present-day Garden County, Nebraska.

zh.s: 灰溪谷战役又称蓝水溪战役或哈尼大屠杀，是第一次苏族战争中的一场战斗，于1855年9月2日至3日发生在普拉特河沿岸、今内布拉斯加州加登县一带。交战双方是威廉·S·哈尼准将率领的美国陆军士兵和一支锡坎古拉科塔人队伍。

en.s: The 1861 Vermont gubernatorial election for governor of Vermont was held on Tuesday, September 3. In keeping with the "Mountain Rule", incumbent Republican Erastus Fairbanks, who had also served as governor from 1852 to 1853, was not a candidate for a third one-year term. The Republican nominee was Frederick Holbrook, a former member of the Vermont Senate.

zh.s: 佛蒙特州于9月3日（星期二）举行州长选举。按照“山岳规则”，曾于1852至1853年担任州长的时任共和党州长埃拉斯特斯·费尔班克斯没有竞选第三个一年任期。共和党提名人是曾任佛蒙特州参议员的弗雷德里克·霍尔布鲁克。

en.s: The Battle of Acton (also referred to as the Battle of Kelly's Bluff) was fought between the United States Army and the warrior bands of Chief Little Crow and Walker Among Stones during the Dakota War of 1862. Following the defeats at Fort Ridgley and New Ulm, Chief Little Crow led an incursion north out of the Minnesota River Valley into central Minnesota. Company B of the Tenth Minnesota Infantry Regiment commanded by Captain Richard Strout was sent to protect the citizens of Meeker County. On September 2, Company B made camp near the town of Acton. Strout was warned overnight that the Dakota were encamped with around 100 men nearby split into two groups. Marching southeast on September 3, 1862, Strout's men were attacked by Little Crow's men, then Walker Among Stones's men from the front, rear, and flanks multiple times, but managed to reach the relative safety of the stockaded town of Hutchinson.

zh.s: 阿克顿战役又称凯利崖战役，是1862年达科他战争期间，美国陆军与小乌鸦酋长和沃克·阿蒙·斯通斯率领的战士交战的一场战斗。在美国军队于里奇利堡和新乌尔姆战败后，小乌鸦酋长率军离开明尼苏达河谷，向北进入明尼苏达州中部。理查德·斯特劳特上尉指挥的明尼苏达第10步兵团B连奉命保护米克县居民。9月2日，B连在阿克顿镇附近扎营。夜间有人警告斯特劳特，约100名达科他人分成两组驻扎在附近。1862年9月3日，斯特劳特的队伍向东南行进时，多次遭到小乌鸦部下以及沃克·阿蒙·斯通斯部下从正面、后方和侧翼袭击，但最终抵达有围墙保护的哈钦森镇，暂时脱险。

en.s: The Battle of Panasowka, which took place on September 3, 1863, near the village of Panasowka (currently Bilgoraj County, Lublin Voivodeship), was one of the largest battles of the January Uprising. A unit of Polish insurgents of some 1,200 defeated here a Russian army detachment. The Poles were supported by some 40 Hungarian volunteers under Count Edward Nyary, who himself was wounded and died. Polish insurgents were divided into two units. One was commanded by Colonel Marcin “Lelewel” Borelowski, and consisted of some 700 - 800 irregulars. Second unit was led by Kajetan “Cwiek” Cieszkowski, and had some 400 irregulars.

zh.s: 帕纳苏夫卡战役于1863年9月3日在帕纳苏夫卡村附近爆发，该村现属卢布林省比乌戈拉伊县。这是波兰一月起义期间规模最大的战斗之一。约1,200名波兰起义军在此击败一支俄军分队。爱德华·尼亚里伯爵率领的约40名匈牙利志愿兵也提供支援；尼亚里本人受伤后身亡。波兰起义军分成两支部队：一支由马尔钦·“莱莱韦尔”·博雷洛夫斯基上校率领，约有700至800名非正规军；另一支由卡耶坦·“茨维克”·切什科夫斯基率领，约有400名非正规军。

en.s: The Battle of Whitestone Hill was the culmination of the 1863 operations against the Sioux Indians in Dakota Territory. Brigadier General Alfred Sully attacked a village September 3–5, 1863. The Indians in the village included Yanktonai, Santee, and Teton (Lakota) Sioux. Sully killed, wounded, or captured 300 to 400 Sioux, including women and children, at a cost of about 60 casualties. Sully would continue the conflict with another campaign in 1864 – Sully's Expedition Against the Sioux in Dakota Territory.

zh.s: 怀特斯通山战役是1863年针对苏族人的军事行动的高潮。阿尔弗雷德·萨利准将于1863年9月3日至5日袭击了一个村庄。村中居民包括扬克托奈、桑蒂和提顿（拉科塔）苏族人。萨利杀死、打伤或俘虏了300至400名苏族人，其中包括妇女和儿童；己方伤亡约60人。萨利于1864年继续发动军事行动，即在达科他领地针对苏族人的萨利远征。

en.s: The Ontario general election, 1867 was the first general election held in the newly created Province of Ontario, Canada. Previously, the territory was known as Canada West, a part of the Province of Canada. The election was held on September 3, 1867, to elect the 82 members of the 1st Legislative Assembly (MLAs). The dates of the election in 1867 varied from August 20 to September 26. The Conservative Party, led by John Sandfield Macdonald, and the Ontario Liberal Party, led by Archibald McKellar, each won 41 seats. A coalition government was formed under the leadership of Macdonald.

zh.s: 1867年安大略省大选是加拿大新成立的安大略省举行的首次大选。该地区此前称为加拿大西部，属于加拿大省。选举于1867年9月3日举行，选出第一届立法议会的82名议员。各选区的投票日期从8月20日到9月26日不等。约翰·桑德菲尔德·麦克唐纳领导的保守党和阿奇博尔德·麦凯勒领导的安大略自由党各赢得41席，随后由麦克唐纳领导组成联合政府。

en.s: SS Princess Alice, formerly PS Bute, was a British passenger paddle steamer that sank on 3 September 1878 after a collision with the collier SS Bywell Castle on the River Thames. Between 600 and 700 people died, all from Princess Alice, the greatest loss of life of any British inland waterway shipping accident. No passenger list or headcount was made, so the exact figure of deaths has never been known.

en.t: Siege of the British Residency in Kabul
en.s: The siege of the British Residency in Kabul was a military engagement of the Second Anglo-Afghan War. en.t: Canadian forces advance after breaching the Drocourt–Quéant Line
en.s: On September 3, 1918, Canadian forces advanced about six kilometres toward the Canal du Nord in northern France after breaking through the German Drocourt–Quéant defensive line the previous day. en.t: Battle of Talavera de la Reina (1936)
en.s: The Battle of Talavera de la Reina was fought on September 3, 1936 in the Spanish Civil War. The Republicans, attempting to bar the road to Madrid at Talavera de la Reina, were defeated by the professional army of the Nationalists, with heavy casualties on both sides. In the first days of September, after a fitful retreat along the Tagus, the government militias established themselves in a strong position on the heights above Talavera. Rather than risk the Republic's army defending open country in earlier battles, General Riquelme had yielded ground constantly, allowing him to conserve his forces and muster over 10,000 men at Talavera.

zh.t: 塔拉韦拉-德拉雷ინა战役（1936年）
zh.s: 西班牙内战期间，1936年9月3日发生塔拉韦拉-德拉雷ინა战役。共和军试图在该城拦截通往马德里的道路，但被国民军正规军击败，双方均伤亡惨重。9月初，共和政府民兵沿塔霍河一带断续撤退后，在塔拉韦拉上方高地占据有利位置。里克尔梅将军没有让共和军在此前的战斗中冒险于开阔地作战，而是不断让出阵地，以保存兵力，并在塔拉韦拉集结了1万多人。

en.s: The Battle of Balaa took place on 3 September 1936, when Arab rebels ambushed a detachment of the British Army's Royal Lincolnshire Regiment near the village of Bal'a. The rebels, mostly well-disciplined and well-equipped Transjordanian and Syrian volunteers under Fawzi al-Qawuqji, put up a determined fight, killing at least 3 British soldiers and destroying two planes. In the end, the Arab militants retreated after an 8-hour firefight, with the British Army claiming victory.

It was one of the opening battles of the Invasion of Poland and World War II in general. It was fought between the forces of the Polish Modlin Army under General Krukowicz-Przedrzymirski and the German 3rd Army under General Georg von Küchler.

en.s: The Battle of the Atlantic, the longest continuous military campaign in World War II, ran from 1939 to the defeat of Nazi Germany in 1945, covering a major part of the naval history of World War II. At its core was the Allied naval blockade of Germany, announced the day after the declaration of war, and Germany's subsequent counterblockade. The campaign peaked from mid-1940 to the end of 1943.
en.n: World War II: The United Kingdom and France begin a naval blockade of Germany that lasts until the end of the war. This also marks the beginning of the Battle of the Atlantic.

zh.s: 大西洋海战是第二次世界大战持续时间最长的军事战役，从1939年持续到1945年纳粹德国战败，构成二战海战史的重要部分。战役的核心是盟军宣布对德国实施海上封锁，德国随后也进行反封锁。战事在1940年年中至1943年底最为激烈。

en.s: The Battle of Go Cong was a small battle during the Vietnam War. The intent of the operation was to drive out the rebels who had survived the earlier Ap Bac engagement. The battle was won by American and South Vietnamese forces, after inflicting heavy casualties on the Viet Cong, using artillery to slaughter rebel fighters fleeing American special operation troops who ambushed them with intense sniper fire.

zh.t: 卡塔尔宣布独立，结束与英国的旧条约
zh.s: 1971年9月3日，卡塔尔宣布独立，并终止1916年与英国签订的条约。当时的王储兼首相哈利法·本·哈马德·阿勒萨尼宣布这一决定，卡塔尔埃米尔仍是艾哈迈德·本·阿里·阿勒萨尼。两国随后以新的友好条约取代原有的保护关系。
zh.n: 卡塔尔于1971年9月3日宣布独立，并终止1916年与英国签订的条约。

en.s: The 1972 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final was the 85th All-Ireland Final and the culmination of the 1972 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship, an inter-county hurling tournament for the top teams in Ireland. The match was held at Croke Park, Dublin on 3 September 1972. The match was contested by 1970 winners Cork and 1971 runners-up Kilkenny, and it was refereed by Mick Spain from Offaly.

zh.t: 1972年全爱尔兰高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1972年全爱尔兰高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛是第85届全爱尔兰决赛，也是当年锦标赛的收官战。这项跨郡赛事由爱尔兰各地强队参加。比赛于1972年9月3日在都柏林克罗克公园举行，由1970年冠军科克对阵1971年亚军基尔肯尼，裁判是来自奥法利的米克·斯派恩。

en.s: The 33rd annual Venice International Film Festival was held from 21 August to 3 September 1972. There were no official prizes because the festival was not competitive from 1969 to 1979. However, the critics' jury voted the Swedish film Foreigners, directed by Johan Bergenstrahle, the most worthy in the program. Charlie Chaplin, Anatoli Golovnya and Billy Wilder were awarded the Career Golden Lion.

zh.t: 第33届威尼斯国际电影节
zh.s: 第33届威尼斯国际电影节于1972年8月21日至9月3日举行。由于电影节在1969年至1979年间不设竞赛单元，本届没有官方奖项。不过，影评人评审团将约翰·伯根斯特勒执导的瑞典电影《外来者》评为最值得肯定的影片。查理·卓别林、阿纳托利·戈洛夫尼亚和比利·怀尔德获颁终身成就金狮奖。

en.s: The 1st Deauville American Film Festival took place at Deauville, France from September 3 to 7, 1975. It was created by French writer Lionel Chouchan and French journalist and television producer André Halimi, which they described as "(to) show films that only a few privileged - amazed or astonished – people had discovered, in New York or Los Angeles, to French audiences, without exclusion, barriers or bias".

zh.s: 首届多维尔美国电影节于1975年9月3日至7日在法国多维尔举行。电影节由法国作家利奥内尔·舒尚和法国记者、电视制片人安德烈·阿利米创办。他们表示，举办电影节是为了把少数有机会在纽约或洛杉矶发现、并感到惊喜或震撼的电影介绍给法国观众，不设排斥、门槛或偏见。

en.s: The 1976 Soviet Cup final was a football match that took place at the Lenin's Central Stadium, Moscow on 3 September 1976. The match was the 35th Soviet Cup final and it was contested by defending champions Ararat Yerevan and Dinamo Tbilisi. Goals from David Kipiani, Piruz Kanteladze and Revaz Chelebadze helped Dinamo Tbilisi to a 3–0 win as they won the cup for the first time.

zh.s: 1976年苏联杯决赛于1976年9月3日在莫斯科列宁中央体育场举行，是第35届苏联杯决赛。卫冕冠军埃里温阿拉拉特队对阵第比利斯迪纳摩队。大卫·基皮亚尼、皮鲁兹·坎特拉泽和列瓦兹·切列巴泽分别进球，帮助第比利斯迪纳摩以3比0获胜，首次夺得苏联杯。

en.s: The Viking program consisted of a pair of identical American space probes, Viking 1 and Viking 2 both launched in 1975, and landed on Mars in 1976. The mission effort began in 1968 and was managed by the NASA Langley Research Center. Each spacecraft was composed of two main parts: an orbiter spacecraft which photographed the surface of Mars from orbit, and a lander which studied the planet from the surface.
en.n: Viking program: The American Viking 2 spacecraft lands at Utopia Planitia on Mars.

zh.s: 海盗计划由两艘相同的美国太空探测器组成：海盗1号和海盗2号。两艘探测器都于1975年发射，并于1976年登陆火星。该计划始于1968年，由美国国家航空航天局兰利研究中心管理。每艘探测器都由两部分组成：轨道器在火星轨道拍摄地表，着陆器则在火星表面进行研究。
zh.n: 海盗计划：美国海盗2号探测器在火星乌托邦平原着陆。

en.s: Air Rhodesia Flight 825 was a scheduled passenger flight that was shot down by the Zimbabwe People's Revolutionary Army (ZIPRA) on 3 September 1978, during the Rhodesian Bush War. The aircraft involved, a Vickers Viscount named the Hunyani, was flying the last leg of Air Rhodesia's regular scheduled service from Victoria Falls to the capital Salisbury, via the resort town of Kariba.

zh.s: 罗得西亚丛林战争期间，罗得西亚航空825号定期客运航班于1978年9月3日被津巴布韦人民革命军（ZIPRA）击落。涉事飞机是一架名为“洪亚尼号”的维克斯子爵客机，正在执行罗得西亚航空从维多利亚瀑布城经度假小镇卡里巴飞往首都索尔兹伯里的定期航班最后一段航程。

en.t: Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination Against Women
en.s: The Convention on the Elimination of all Forms of Discrimination Against Women (CEDAW) is an international treaty adopted in 1979 by the United Nations General Assembly. Described as an international bill of rights for women, it was instituted on 3 September 1981 and has been ratified by 189 states.

zh.s: 《消除对妇女一切形式歧视公约》（CEDAW）是联合国大会于1979年通过的一项国际条约，被称为妇女的国际权利法案。公约于1981年9月3日生效，已有189个国家批准。

en.s: The Mountain War (Arabic: حرب الجبل, romanized: Ḥarb al-Jabal), also known as the War of the Mountain, was a subconflict between the 1982–83 and the 1984–89 phase of the Lebanese Civil War, which occurred mainly at the mountainous Chouf District located south-east of the Lebanese Capital Beirut.

en.s: The 1987 Burundian coup d'état was a bloodless military coup d'état that took place in Burundi on 3 September 1987. Tutsi president Jean-Baptiste Bagaza was deposed whilst traveling abroad and succeeded by Tutsi Major Pierre Buyoya.

zh.s: 1987年9月3日，布隆迪发生一场不流血的军事政变。图西族总统让-巴蒂斯特·巴加扎在出国期间被推翻，由图西族少校皮埃尔·布约亚接任。

en.s: General elections were held in Singapore on 3 September 1988. The result was a victory for the People's Action Party, which won 80 of the 81 seats. Voter turnout was 94.7%, although this figure represents the turnout in the 50 constituencies to be contested, with PAP candidates earning walkovers in the other 31.

en.s: The 1988 National Soccer League Grand Final was the fourth National Soccer League Grand Final, the championship-deciding match of the Australian National Soccer League and the culmination of the 1988 season. The match was played between Sydney Croatia and Marconi Fairfield on 3 September 1988 at Parramatta Stadium in Sydney. This was the first NSL Grand Final for both teams.

zh.t: 1988年澳大利亚全国足球联赛总决赛
zh.s: 1988年澳大利亚全国足球联赛总决赛是该联赛第4场总决赛，也是决定冠军归属的比赛和1988赛季的收官战。悉尼克罗地亚队与马可尼费尔菲尔德队于1988年9月3日在悉尼帕拉马塔体育场交手。这是两队首次参加该联赛总决赛。

The match was held at Croke Park, Dublin, on 3 September 1989, between Tipperary, managed by Bab's Keating and Antrim, managed by Jim Nelson.

zh.t: 1989年全爱尔兰高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛

en.s: Cubana de Aviación Flight 9046 was a chartered Ilyushin Il-62M airliner (registered CU-T1281) operated by Cubana, which crashed on 3 September 1989, shortly after takeoff from José Martí International Airport. Flight 9046 was due to operate a non-scheduled international Havana-Cologne-Milan passenger service. The crash resulted in the deaths of all 126 occupants of the aircraft plus 24 people on the ground.

zh.s: 古巴航空9046号包机是一架伊留申伊尔-62M客机，注册号为CU-T1281，于1989年9月3日在何塞·马蒂国际机场起飞后不久坠毁。该航班原计划执行哈瓦那—科隆—米兰的非定期国际客运航线。机上126人和地面24人全部遇难。

en.s: Varig Flight 254 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight from São Paulo, Brazil, to Belém, capital city of the state of Pará in the country's North Region. On 3 September 1989, the Boeing 737-200 operating this flight had several intermediate stopovers, the last being in Marabá, Pará. Prior to takeoff from Marabá, the crew entered an incorrect heading into the flight computer, flying deep into a remote area of the Amazon jungle.

zh.s: 巴西航空254号班机是从巴西圣保罗飞往帕拉州首府贝伦的定期国内客运航班。1989年9月3日，执飞该航班的波音737-200在途中停靠数站，最后一站是帕拉州的马拉巴。飞机从马拉巴起飞前，机组人员在飞行电脑中输入了错误的航向，导致飞机深入亚马孙丛林偏远地区。

en.s: The Maracanazo of the Chilean team (Spanish: Maracanazo de la selección chilena), also known as the Condorazo or Bengalazo, was a scandal that occurred during a 1990 FIFA World Cup qualifying match between Brazil and Chile at the Maracanã Stadium in Rio de Janeiro on 3 September 1989. Chilean goalkeeper Roberto Rojas feigned injury after a flare thrown by a Brazilian supporter landed near him, prompting the Chilean team to abandon the match in protest.

zh.t: 智利队的马拉卡纳惨案
zh.s: 智利队的“马拉卡纳惨案”（西班牙语：Maracanazo de la selección chilena），也称“秃鹰事件”或“火炬事件”，是1989年9月3日发生的一桩丑闻。当时巴西与智利在里约热内卢的马拉卡纳体育场进行1990年世界杯预选赛。巴西球迷投掷的信号弹落在智利门将罗伯托·罗哈斯附近，他假装受伤，智利队随后以抗议为由退赛。

en.s: The 1995 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final (sponsored by Guinness) was the 108th All-Ireland Final and the culmination of the 1995 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship, an inter-county hurling tournament for the top teams in Ireland. The match was held at Croke Park, Dublin, on 3 September 1995, between Clare and Offaly. The Leinster champions lost to their Munster opponents on a score line of 1-13 to 2-8.

zh.t: 1995年全爱尔兰高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1995年全爱尔兰高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛由健力士赞助，是第108届全爱尔兰决赛，也是当年锦标赛的收官战。这项跨郡赛事由爱尔兰各地强队参加。决赛于1995年9月3日在都柏林克罗克公园举行，由克莱尔对阵奥法利。伦斯特冠军奥法利以2球8分负于芒斯特对手克莱尔的1球13分。

en.t: Royal Hong Kong Regiment disbands after 141 years
en.s: On September 3, 1995, the Royal Hong Kong Regiment (The Volunteers) was disbanded. Its roots went back to the Hong Kong Volunteers formed in 1854, giving the local volunteer force a history of about 141 years. The disbandment came before the 1997 transfer of Hong Kong from British to Chinese sovereignty; a veterans’ association continued afterward.
en.n: The regiment disbanded on September 3, 1995; its successor association continued separately.

zh.s: 1995年9月3日，香港皇家军团（义勇军）正式解散。它的前身是1854年成立的香港义勇军，作为本地志愿部队已有约141年历史。军团解散时距1997年香港主权移交还有两年；退伍军人协会此后继续运作。
zh.n: 军团于1995年9月3日解散；退伍军人协会并未随之结束。

en.s: The 1996 Dade County mayoral election took place on October 1, 1996, following a primary election on September 3, 1996. The election was the first one to take place following an October 1992 referendum that established the office following the 1992 abolition of the previous mayoral position, which was largely ceremonial.

en.s: Vietnam Airlines Flight 815 was a scheduled Vietnam Airlines flight which crashed on final approach to Pochentong International Airport in Cambodia on 3 September 1997. The Soviet-built Tupolev Tu-134 airliner crashed approximately 800 metres (2,600 ft; 870 yd) short of the Phnom Penh runway, killing 65 of the 66 people on board. As of February 2024, it remains the deadliest accident in Cambodian history.

zh.s: 越南航空815号班机是一趟定期航班，于1997年9月3日在柬埔寨金边波成东国际机场进近时坠毁。这架苏联制造的图-134客机在距金边机场跑道约800米（2,600英尺；870码）处坠毁，机上66人中有65人遇难。截至2024年2月，这仍是柬埔寨历史上伤亡最惨重的空难。

en.t: Tipperary beats Cork in the All-Ireland senior camogie final
en.s: On September 3, 2000, Tipperary defeated Cork in the All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship final at Croke Park in Dublin. Tipperary scored 2-11 to Cork's 1-9, winning by five points.
en.n: The final was played at Croke Park on September 3, 2000; the Camogie Association records Tipperary's 2-11 to 1-9 victory over Cork.

zh.t: 蒂珀雷里郡在全爱尔兰高级卡莫吉决赛中击败科克郡
zh.s: 2000年9月3日，蒂珀雷里郡在都柏林克罗克公园举行的全爱尔兰高级卡莫吉锦标赛决赛中击败科克郡。蒂珀雷里以2-11比1-9获胜，领先5分。

en.s: The Beslan school siege, also referred to as the Beslan school hostage crisis or the Beslan massacre, was a terrorist attack that occurred from 1 September 2004 to 3 September 2004 in the town of Beslan, North Ossetia, Russia. zh.s: 2006年洛杉矶之战是职业摔角游击队（PWG）举办的第二届同名锦标赛，为期三晚，于2006年9月1日至3日在加利福尼亚州雷西达的美国退伍军人协会308号分会举行。共有24名选手参赛，第三晚的决赛中戴维·理查兹击败CIMA夺冠。

en.s: The 2006 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final was a hurling match held at Croke Park, Dublin on 3 September 2006. The match was the 119th All-Ireland hurling final and was contested by Kilkenny and Cork, with Kilkenny putting in a fiercely determined and intense performance to win 1–16 to 1–13. It was the first meeting of these two sides in the All-Ireland final since 2004 when Cork were the winners.

en.s: TripleSEM was a professional wrestling major show event produced in cooperation between Pro Wrestling Noah (NOAH) and Asistencia Asesoría y Administración (AAA) on September 3, 2007 held in Tokyo, Japan and shown live on Gaora TV. The show is so far the only joint NOAH/AAA promoted show, but as the companies still work together there is potential for further joint shows in the future. en.s: General elections were held in Jamaica on 3 September 2007. They had originally been scheduled for 27 August 2007 but were delayed due to Hurricane Dean. The preliminary results indicated a slim victory for the opposition Jamaican Labour Party led by Bruce Golding, which grew by two seats from 31-29 to 33-27 after official recounts. The JLP defeated the People's National Party after eighteen years of unbroken governance.

en.s: The Angur Ada raid (Pashto: د انګور اډې بريد‎) was a covert raid conducted by U.S. Navy SEALs against Taliban fighters on September 3, 2008, within the border town of Angur Ada in South Waziristan. It was the first time American Troops fought a ground-based battle against the Taliban within Pakistani borders. The raid took place at the same time as Pakistani military forces ended a four-week offensive in Bajaur, the northernmost Agency of the Federally Administered Tribal Areas of which South Waziristan is the southernmost, an offensive that has displaced approximately half a million people.

zh.s: 安古尔阿达突袭（普什图语：د انګور اډې بريد‎）是美国海军海豹突击队于2008年9月3日在南瓦济里斯坦边境城镇安古尔阿达对塔利班武装人员实施的一次秘密突袭。这是美军首次在巴基斯坦境内与塔利班进行地面战斗。突袭发生时，巴基斯坦军队刚结束在巴焦尔地区为期四周的攻势；巴焦尔是联邦直辖部落地区最北端的特区，南瓦济里斯坦则位于最南端。那场攻势迫使约50万人流离失所。

en.s: UPS Airlines Flight 6 was a scheduled international cargo flight operated by UPS Airlines. en.s: General elections were held in Jamaica on Thursday, 3 September 2020 to elect 63 members of Parliament. As the constitution stipulates a five-year parliamentary term, the next elections were not expected until between 25 February and 10 June 2021. However, Prime Minister Andrew Holness called early elections to ensure a united response to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic. On the advice of Holness, Governor General Patrick Allen dissolved Parliament on 13 August 2020.
